hospitalDetails.name: Orlando Health Bayfront Hospital — Center for Women and Babies
hospitalDetails.paragraph: The Center for Women and Babies sits on the third floor of Johns Hopkins All Children's Hospital, which means the labor and delivery suites are backed by a children's hospital and its NICU — the kind of safety net that matters if the baby arrives early. Expect private rooms, a family-centered birth floor, and direct adjacency to pediatric and neonatology care, which is why it is one of the most-requested delivery hospitals in Pinellas County. Use our free birth plan template before your admission so your preferences travel with you.
hospitalDetails.doulaPolicy: Doulas welcome as one of the two support persons
hospitalDetails.languageAccess: Interpreter services available in labor and delivery

hospitalDetails.name: HCA Florida St. Petersburg Hospital — Women's Center
hospitalDetails.paragraph: HCA Florida St. Petersburg is a 215-bed full-service hospital whose secure labor and delivery unit runs on private rooms, certified nurses, and skilled physicians — the classic full-hospital experience, two minutes from the downtown causeway views. Certified nurse-midwives attend deliveries here, IBCLCs cover lactation, and the Leapfrog safety grade includes allowing patients to bring their own doulas, so your support person travels with you from the first kick-throughs to the last contraction. Bring a finished birth plan — this unit honors them and they'll ask for it at triage.
hospitalDetails.doulaPolicy: Doulas welcome — patients may bring their own (Leapfrog)
hospitalDetails.lactationSupport: IBCLCs on staff; outpatient lactation clinic

birthCenterDetails.name: Breath of Life Women's Health & Birth Center
birthCenterDetails.credential: CABC Accredited — Florida's only accredited birth center
birthCenterDetails.paragraph: Breath of Life, located at 1900 East Bay Drive in Largo, is the only birth center in Florida that holds CABC accreditation — a real distinction in a state where freestanding birth centers are rare. Midwives lead the care, the rooms feel more like a very good guest house than a clinic, and the center lists St. Petersburg among the areas its teams cover, which makes it one of the few out-of-hospital options families on the Pinellas side can actually commit to. Ask about transfer protocols at your first visit; every accredited center keeps them tight, and knowing the drill is half the peace of mind.
birthCenterDetails.distance: About 25 minutes east of downtown St. Petersburg
